title: HB 2241 (107th General Assembly): As introduced, permits a valid photo identification card issued by a county or city to its employee to be used as identification for verifying the person's identify on an application for ballot. - Amends TCA Section 2-7-112.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) 2-7-112(c)(7) (Section 1)
(quote) (7) A valid identification card issued by a Tennessee county or municipality to an employee of that county or municipality shall be evidence of identification for purposes of verifying the person's identification on the application for ballot; provided, that such identification contains a photograph of the voter.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Sections 2-3: conforming punctuation ('or' moved from (c)(5) to (c)(6)).
(other) Section 4: effective on becoming law.
(other) version: 511581-Draft (2012-01-09): the only saved version; adds government-employee photo ID to the accepted-ID list (slot a).
(other) note: Failed 3-5 on 2012-03-14. Slot a only.
